name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
purpose: A small trend line beside a value, with words that say the trend and the latest value.
whenToUse: Beside a number in a table cell or a stat, to show how it moved over the last few runs or days.
For one series of 5 to 30 points where the shape matters and the single values do not.
whenNotToUse: By itself, with no value and no words. The line cannot be read as a number.
When the reader needs single values, axes or more than one series. Use a table, or a chart the app builds for the purpose.
For progress towards a known total. Use the progress bar or the usage meter.
For one number with its comparison and nothing over time. Use the stat alone.
As decoration on a card or a heading.

variants.name: with words
variants.use: The default. gw-sparkline__text after the drawing says the trend, the period and the latest value in a short visible line.

variants.name: words for screen readers only
variants.use: The same sentence in a span with gw-visually-hidden in place of gw-sparkline__text, where the value and the period are already visible in the same row and a table has no room for the line of text.

sizes.name: default
sizes.use: 64px wide and 16px tall, with a 1.5px line. It fits a table row and a line of text without adding height.

accessibility: Use a span with the class gw-sparkline holding the svg and then the words. The svg carries aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false": the drawing is not announced, and the words carry everything it shows.

The words are required. They say the direction, the period and the latest value with its unit, such as Rising over the last 7 runs, now 6 min 12 s. Put them in gw-sparkline__text, or in gw-visually-hidden when the same row already shows the value. Direction is a word, Rising, Falling or Steady, never the line's slope or a colour alone.

The app generates the svg: viewBox="0 0 64 16", one polyline with the class gw-sparkline__line, and one circle with the class gw-sparkline__last and r="2" on the last point. Spread the points evenly from x=2 to x=62 and scale the values so the lowest is at y=14 and the highest at y=2. When every value is the same, draw the line at y=8.

The line and the dot are drawn in the main text colour through currentColor, in both themes. Do not set a stroke or fill attribute, and do not add a fill under the line, a gradient, grid lines or an animation.
Do not colour the line by whether the change is good or bad. If that judgement matters, write it in the words.
With fewer than two values there is no line. Leave the svg out and write that in gw-sparkline__text: Not enough runs for a trend yet.
The component has no controls and needs no script beyond generating the points.
